question: What mastery is attained through the prescribed yantra practice?
premises: The eight siddhis beginning with aṇimā are named
inference: The practitioner becomes lord of the eight siddhis beginning with aṇimā.
uncertainties: The term cirāt can suggest after a long time or in due course
plain_english: One becomes lord of the eight siddhis beginning with aṇimā in due time.
